article.headline: Nique Clifford's double-double propels Colorado State to 79-63 victory over Wyoming
article.description: — Nique Clifford had 23 points and 11 rebounds to power Colorado State to a 79-63 victory over Wyoming on Saturday.
article.linkText: Nique Clifford's double-double propels Colorado State to 79-63 victory over Wyoming
article.story: LARAMIE, Wyo. -- — Nique Clifford had 23 points and 11 rebounds to power Colorado State to a 79-63 victory over Wyoming on Saturday. Clifford also handed out five assists for the Rams (11-7, 5-2 Mountain West Conference). Jaylen Crocker-Johnson had 11 points and seven rebounds. Jalen Lake scored 10. Obi Agbim led the way for the Cowboys (9-9, 2-5) with 26 points and six rebounds. Dontaie Allen added 14 points. Colorado State took the lead with 16:08 left in the first half and did not relinquish it. The score was 36-28 at halftime, with Crocker-Johnson racking up nine points. Clifford scored 17 in the second half. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
